evidence_conflicts.conflict: amd64-02 repository metadata declares an RTX 3060 Ti and 8 GiB, while live PCI evidence identifies the device as an RTX 3060 LHR. The model identity is contradicted; the 8 GiB VRAM declaration is not validated by the supplied current runtime evidence and must remain unresolved rather than being silently carried forward.
evidence_conflicts.why_it_matters: GPU identity and verified memory capacity constrain model fit, serving-runtime options, placement, and qualification criteria.

Use current repository-owned qualification and evidence mechanisms.
Prove Kubernetes nvidia.com/gpu exposure and intended GPU execution.

required_adaptation_or_revalidation: Replace MicroK8s-specific enablement with K3s-compatible mechanisms.
Revalidate against current driver, containerd, and device-plugin/operator compatibility.

Add only independently trusted and exactly locked artifacts if an NVIDIA chart is selected.
Preserve the repository's isolated Helm execution contract.

bounded_engineering_inferences.inference: The Kalaxy2 CUDA-pass evidence makes real workload execution a strong candidate validation pattern for Kalaxy3, but not proof that any historical installation mechanism will work on K3s.
bounded_engineering_inferences.not_a_fact_because: Transferability from MicroK8s/GTX 1070 to K3s/current RTX hardware has not been executed or validated.

bounded_engineering_inferences.inference: Any NVIDIA operator/device-plugin approach considered for Kalaxy3 will likely need to conform to the repository's existing explicit Helm trust, exact chart locking, and isolated execution patterns.
bounded_engineering_inferences.not_a_fact_because: No accepted NVIDIA Helm integration is established in the packet; the only such work described is untrusted candidate state.

bounded_engineering_inferences.inference: The initial amd64-02 serving placement should remain conditional during architecture reasoning until its current VRAM and usable GPU runtime capacity are directly established.
bounded_engineering_inferences.not_a_fact_because: The packet supplies an initial placement direction and stale repository VRAM metadata, but no current runtime VRAM measurement or successful GPU-runtime qualification for amd64-02.

bounded_engineering_inferences.inference: The indexed Kalaxy2 AI documentation is potentially valuable retrieval prior art, but it cannot currently support a comparison of Ollama, vLLM, OpenWebUI, fine-tuning, monitoring, or serving implementation choices.
bounded_engineering_inferences.not_a_fact_because: Only file/topic existence is supplied; the actual page content, commands, design choices, outcomes, and limitations are absent.

evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.gap: Actual Kalaxy2 page contents for Ollama, OpenWebUI, vLLM, fine-tuning, LLM setup, monitoring, and serving are not supplied.
evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.why_needed: The Architect explicitly requires applicable Kalaxy2 prior art to inform the bounded cognition episode. Topic existence alone cannot establish what was implemented, selected, learned, or proven.
evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.preferred_source_type: Original Kalaxy2 markdown/page source bytes with provenance and content hashes for the indexed AI documents.

evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.gap: Current runtime VRAM for amd64-02 is not established; the only 8 GiB value is tied to stale repository metadata that also misidentifies the GPU model.
evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.why_needed: Verified GPU memory is required to reason safely about model fit, quantization, concurrency, serving runtime suitability, and whether the initial amd64-02 placement remains viable.
evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.preferred_source_type: Current live GPU runtime evidence from amd64-02 after a trusted driver is available, such as nvidia-smi or equivalent authoritative hardware/runtime inspection.

evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.gap: No accepted current live NVIDIA driver/container-runtime/K3s GPU qualification exists for either Kalaxy3 GPU node in the packet.
evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.why_needed: Architecture alternatives that depend on Kubernetes GPU scheduling must distinguish desired capability from presently proven capability and identify compatibility constraints.
evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.preferred_source_type: Current host and K3s runtime qualification evidence covering driver, NVIDIA container runtime/toolkit, containerd integration, nvidia.com/gpu advertisement, and a successful GPU workload.

evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.gap: The packet does not establish the intended model set, model sizes or quantization expectations, context lengths, concurrency, latency/throughput targets, or other serving workload requirements.
evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.why_needed: Those requirements materially affect runtime alternatives, GPU capacity, placement, storage, and performance tradeoffs.
evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.preferred_source_type: Architect-owned workload requirements or an authoritative current SAGE/shared-inference usage profile.

evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.gap: The packet does not establish current live storage capacity/performance for model persistence or the network/exposure/authentication constraints for the shared endpoint.
evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.why_needed: The Definition of Done requires appropriate persistent storage and reachable machine-neutral workstation access; safe architecture alternatives need the current constraints rather than invented defaults.
evidence_gaps_or_unknowns.preferred_source_type: Current Kalaxy3 storage-class/capacity observations plus authoritative network, ingress, TLS/authentication, and workstation-access constraints.

material_architect_decision_surfaces.why_material: The choice affects compatibility, model support, operational complexity, GPU utilization, and the machine-neutral endpoint contract.
evidence_needed_before_decision: Actual Kalaxy2 Ollama/vLLM/serving page contents and outcomes.
Verified current GPU memory/runtime capability on candidate nodes.

material_architect_decision_surfaces.decision: Confirm or revise the initial amd64-02 model-serving placement and the intended role of amd64-01.
material_architect_decision_surfaces.why_material: The current objective prefers amd64-02 and preserves the RTX 3090 for higher-value AI workloads, but amd64-02 memory/capability is not yet runtime-proven and its repository identity is stale.
evidence_needed_before_decision: Current amd64-02 VRAM and GPU runtime qualification.
Current amd64-01 runtime qualification and competing workload constraints.

material_architect_decision_surfaces.decision: Choose the persistent storage and endpoint exposure/security shape for the shared service.

Current network/ingress path and workstation reachability constraints.

next_capability_recommendation.reason: The packet is sufficient to establish historical Kalaxy2 GPU experience, current Kalaxy3 constraints, one hardware-identity conflict, and several transferable validation/governance patterns, but it is not sufficient for safe architecture innovation because the actual Kalaxy2 inference-serving page contents, amd64-02 runtime VRAM/capability, and key serving workload requirements are missing.
